title: LC518/150 owner mutation-design annex intake form schema v1.0
description: Machine-readable form for the owner-supplied mutation-design annex (work order line 45). This schema and its auditor implement ONLY the structural and audit rules already frozen in the LC518 protocol (C1-C7) and the work order (:45, :47, Sections 3, 11). They contain no mutation content, propose none, and pre-fill none. Supplying annex content is an owner act; running the auditor is a mechanical check, not an authorization.

provenance_statement.description: Owner statement of channel and date of delivery per protocol C0 (recorded owner channel; no public commit of annex text).

mechanisms.description: Protocol C1: exactly eight mechanisms, each with a definition. Fail if any mechanism lacks a definition or count != 8.

pair_assignments.description: Protocol C2/C3: exactly 30 assignments, one-to-one onto parents G01-G30; all 28 unordered mechanism pairs appear at least once; exactly two distinct preselected pairs appear one additional time. Each assignment declares which mechanism is mutation A (SA/SB orientation).

is_replication.description: true only for the two preselected replicated pairs.

preselection_evidence.description: Required when is_replication is true: evidence the replication was preselected before construction (protocol C2).

declared_before_construction.description: Work order line 47 / protocol C2: the two replicated pairs must be preselected before source construction.

s_extra_assignments.description: Work order line 47 / protocol C5: 30 S-extra assignments, one per parent, balanced across the eight mechanisms as closely as integer counts permit (audit expectation: six mechanisms at 4, two at 3).

cd_feasibility_witnesses_documented.description: Protocol C6: the annex must actually document the witnesses for within-cell C_D-value feasibility.
